mapper.select: SELECT DATE(sale_date) as date, SUM(total_amount) as total_amount, SUM(quantity) as quantity FROM flower_sales_history WHERE sale_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(sale_date) ORDER BY date

SELECT id, order_id, flower_id, customer_id, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, sale_date, sale_time, payment_method, salesperson, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM flower_sales_history WHERE sale_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY sale_date
SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(total_amount) as total_amount FROM flower_sales_history GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT YEAR(sale_date) as date, SUM(total_amount) as total_amount, SUM(quantity) as quantity FROM flower_sales_history WHERE sale_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 YEAR) GROUP BY YEAR(sale_date) ORDER BY date

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(sale_date), '-Q', QUARTER(sale_date)) as date, SUM(total_amount) as total_amount, SUM(quantity) as quantity FROM flower_sales_history WHERE sale_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR) GROUP BY YEAR(sale_date), QUARTER(sale_date) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%Y-%m') as date, SUM(total_amount) as total_amount, SUM(quantity) as quantity FROM flower_sales_history WHERE sale_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY date
